title: NHRC, India takessuo motucognizance of the reported sexual harassment of three journalists by Delhi Police personnel during a protest at Jantar Mantar, New Delhi on 3rd October 2026
subtitle: Issues a notice to the Delhi Police Commissioner, calling for a detailed report on the matter within two weeks
body_text:
The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC), India has taken suo motu cognizance of a media report that three women journalists were subjected to sexual harassment by Delhi Police personnel during a protest at Jantar Mantar, New Delhi on 3 rd October 2026.
The Commission has observed that the contents of the news report, if true, raise serious issues of violation of human rights. Accordingly, it has issued a notice to the Delhi Police Commissioner, calling for a detailed report on the matter within two weeks.
According to the media report, carried on 5 th October 2026, the New Delhi District Police received complaints about the alleged incidents, which were transferred to the Crime Branch of Delhi Police for an enquiry.
